rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that cannot continue or be maintained in the long term.

example.english: This way of relying on constant overtime to meet targets is unsustainable.
example.traditional: 呢種靠不斷加班去追數嘅做法唔可持續。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 kaau3 bat1 dyun6 gaa1 baan1 heoi3 zeoi1 sou3 ge3 zou6 faat3 m4 ho2 ci4 zuk6

rows.note: Use this when stressing that a particular level, system, or arrangement cannot be maintained.

example.english: If we have so few staff for the long term, this level of service is unsustainable.
example.traditional: 如果長期得咁少人手，呢個服務水平維持唔到。
example.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 coeng4 kei4 dak1 gam3 siu2 jan4 sau2 ni1 go3 fuk6 mou6 seoi2 ping4 wai4 ci4 m4 dou2
